property_summary: When RState is BELOW_ONE, calling correctRState never increases BASE_TARGET above BASE_RESERVE (BASE_TARGET <= BASE_RESERVE).

If the pool is in BELOW_ONE state, after buyShares the stored BASE_TARGET is never greater than the previous BASE_TARGET plus the base input added to reserves (i.e., BASE_TARGET does not increase by more than the base input portion of the buy).
After calling buyShares, BASE_TARGET is set to a value not less than the previous BASE_TARGET (i.e., BASE_TARGET never decreases as a result of buyShares).

After calling correctRState when RState is ABOVE_ONE and QUOTE_RESERVE is less than QUOTE_TARGET, the contract's RState remains ABOVE_ONE (i.e. correctRState should not reset RState to ONE when quote reserve is below target).

After buyShares from the initial state, if BASE_RESERVE < BASE_TARGET or QUOTE_RESERVE < QUOTE_TARGET then calling buyShares does not increase BASE_TARGET beyond BASE_RESERVE (i.e., BASE_TARGET is set to at most BASE_RESERVE); the mutant can violate this by increasing BASE_TARGET when QUOTE_RESERVE exceeds QUOTE_TARGET.

After buyShares, if _RState_ was ABOVE_ONE and _QUOTE_RESERVE_ was less-than-or-equal-to _QUOTE_TARGET_ before the call, then _BASE_TARGET_ will not increase beyond its previous value (i.e. new BASE_TARGET <= old BASE_TARGET) — the mutant can erroneously increase BASE_TARGET when quote reserve becomes greater-than target.
